taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Current-taxonomy review against VIGIL Failure Taxonomy 0.6.5 retains the occurrence as unclassified. VIGIL-FC-000078 Defective-State Carryforward Failure was tested but is not independently established because the preserved evidence does not show a bounded continuity transition carrying materially defective, stale, contradicted or improperly scoped state that the receiving system then relied upon without revalidation. VIGIL-FC-000035 Material Work-State Persistence Failure was also considered but the evidence describes older strategic commitments being displaced or underweighted, not their loss from durable resumable state across an interruption or transition. VIGIL-FC-000012 Cross-Context Lineage Distortion is not established because no material cross-context transfer with lost provenance or applicability information is evidenced. The strategic-continuity loss remains real in the bounded record, but no selectable current class is asserted without additional mechanism evidence.

Accepted mappings: none. Rejected or not independently established: VIGIL-FC-000078: no evidenced defective inherited state across a continuity transition; VIGIL-FC-000035: displacement/underweighting is not evidence that resumable work state failed to persist; VIGIL-FC-000012: no evidenced cross-context transfer losing provenance or applicability. Primary classification changed: no — remains unclassified. Existing classifications retained: none. Review used preserved canonical Incident evidence only and performed no new external research. Retained unclassified under taxonomy 0.6.5; strategic-continuity weighting remains a possible taxonomy-gap signal, but no new class is proposed in this campaign.

assessment_boundaries: The occurrence is an internal interaction record and is not presented as independent evidence of platform-wide behaviour.
The contextual research does not prove the mechanism in this specific session.
No current class is forced onto the record: FC-000078, FC-000035 and FC-000012 remain adjacent but not independently established.
vigil_assessment.factual_basis: The preserved CAM interaction record describes a bounded ChatGPT session in which recent conversational material reportedly displaced older strategic commitments that remained relevant to the user's governing objective. Independent multi-turn research provides mechanism context but is not occurrence proof.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The occurrence concerns prioritisation of strategically governing continuity, not simple memory presence or absence. State can remain technically available while being weighted so weakly that a recent local theme displaces an older but still governing objective. The current taxonomy does not cleanly distinguish this weighting failure from durable-state loss or defective-state carryforward.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: INC-000011 remains useful as a taxonomy-gap signal: continuity governance needs not only persistence and provenance, but a principled way to preserve which unresolved commitments continue to govern the next turn when context competes for attention.

source_clause_analysis.purpose: Resolve the internal occurrence into current taxonomy boundaries while preserving the strategic-continuity gap rather than manufacturing a class fit.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Continuity requires preservation of governing relevance and priority, not merely retention of textual state.

Defective-State Carryforward is adjacent, but the occurrence does not show a defective inherited state being accepted without revalidation.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A continuity mechanism should distinguish stale state from still-governing commitments whose priority must survive newer but subordinate context.
